invalid: Complete the readings within the indicated input ranges to see a result.
chartDescription: Monthly heat demand and delivered heat in megawatt-hours. Exact values are in the results table.

zeroDemand: The selected building demand is zero.
zeroCapture: No rack heat is available in the liquid loop.
direct: The rack return clears the 3 K approach, so heat transfers directly.
tooCool: The rack return is too cool for direct supply at the requested temperature.
lift: The heat pump lifts the delivery temperature whenever demand and rack heat are available.
heatSummary: {route} The building requests {demand} MWh. {unmet} MWh remains for its other heating system.

benchSummary: Water carries {duty} kW against a prediction of {predicted} kW. The signed difference is {difference} kW.
